A Sorvathi woman with skin of deep teal shading to pale aquamarine at the jaw, a pair of long backswept sapphire horns, gill-slits traced in silver along her neck, luminous sea-glass eyes with no visible pupil, and a cascade of thick bioluminescent blue-green tendrils in place of hair.

A human woman with deep ebony skin, gold-leaf eyelids that catch every angle of light, sharp hazel eyes rimmed with chrome, and a towering mane of tightly coiled copper-dyed hair worn loose and enormous around her face.

A Vaelthari woman with fine coral-pink scales that deepen to crimson at the temples, a tall translucent dorsal crest rising from her brow to the base of her skull, four narrow amber eyes arranged in a wide arc, and no hair, her scalp plated in overlapping pearlescent coral.

A Drossine woman with skin of polished bronze-green shot through with veins of slow amber light, a crown of four short ridged horns curving outward, wide mirror-silver eyes with slit pupils, and heavy coiling tentacle-locks of deep gold that shift and resettle on their own.

A human woman with warm honey-brown skin, a shaved head covered in fine circuit tattoos that pulse faint violet at the temples, mirror-chrome rings around her dark brown irises, and two thin silver braids falling from the nape.

A Quelhari woman with skin the colour of deep indigo velvet, a pair of enormous moth-like antennae rising from her brow dusted in luminous blue-gold scales, wide compound-structured eyes of faceted emerald, and a thick mane of white hair hanging in loose waves past her shoulders.

A Ceruathi woman with bone-white skin traced in branching teal veins that glow softly in low light, four eyes stacked in two close pairs all of deep amber, small swept-back ear-fins, and ink-black tentacle-locks that move in slow independent coils.

A human woman with rich warm sienna skin, waist-length silver-white braids threaded through with tiny brass rings, sharp chrome-rimmed green irises, and freckles of soft gold scattered across both cheekbones and the bridge of her nose.

A Thyrvaan woman with obsidian skin that throws violet highlights at every edge, a ring of short jet-black horns arranged across her brow like a crown, pupil-less eyes of solid molten gold, and her scalp patterned in ridged cooling-lava texture with no hair.

A Mirathi woman with skin of pale crystalline lavender that refracts light into small internal rainbows, a swept-back mane of translucent crystal filaments growing from her scalp in place of hair, her brow and face fully bare, and wide faceted eyes of shifting rose and violet with no distinct iris.

A human woman with deep brown skin the colour of dark walnut, a mirror-plated jaw that catches and fractures light, bold grey eyes under heavy natural brows, and a high-piled mass of naturally silver hair wrapped in elaborate thick ropes.

A Sulvessi woman with smooth skin of deep sea-blue darkening to near-black at the crown, long trailing bioluminescent stripes running from her temples to her collarbones, wide pale-silver eyes with cross-shaped pupils, and a mane of dense black hair shot through with threads of living blue light.

A Relvari woman with fine iridescent green-gold scales, a long prehensile tail that she drapes forward, delicate sweeping freckle-patterns of teal bioluminescence across her cheekbones, and large gold slit-pupil eyes above a symmetrical arrangement of three small bony facial ridges.

A human woman with porcelain skin, dramatic freckles that glow warm amber under low light, deep copper-red eyes with mirror-chrome rings at the iris edge, and a shaved head except for a single waist-length rope braid of white-blonde hair from the crown.

A Zhaveri woman with moss-green skin textured like living bark, small upward-curving ivory horns above each ear, trailing bioluminescent petal-like growths along her hairline in place of hair, and wide warm-amber eyes with horizontal rectangular pupils.

A Korvathi woman with skin of rich violet-black that blooms to bright amethyst across her brow and cheekbones, a fan of broad feather-like plumes in deep blue and silver rising from her scalp, and large forward-facing eyes of pale gold with fine radial markings.

A human woman with deep tawny brown skin, sculpted high cheekbones, eyes of very pale grey ringed in chrome, circuit tattoos across her shaved scalp that trace slow gold pulses toward the jaw, and no other hair.

A Dhelathi woman with skin of smooth pale coral shading to deep rose at the brow ridge, two pairs of long articulated antennae curving elegantly above her head, wide multi-faceted eyes of turquoise that catch light in interlocking hexagons, and trailing silken filaments of white-gold hanging like hair to her mid-back.

A Vorreth woman with skin of matte deep crimson darkening to arterial black at the hairline, a set of four arms each ending in long tapered fingers, small curved onyx horns swept back from the temples, and close-coiled obsidian hair worn in a tall elaborate column.

A human woman with cool blue-toned deep brown skin, natural white hair worn in a wide afro-halo, bright amber eyes with thin chrome rings, and a mirror-plated bridge across the nose catching every shift of light.

A Thessivari woman with skin of pale gold veined with fine lines of rose-pink light that pulse slowly, a horizontal row of six small eyes all of deep viridian running across her brow, delicate translucent fin-structures framing her jaw, and no hair, her scalp smooth and glowing faintly at the crown.

A Celvhari woman with fine platinum-white scales overlapping like hammered foil, a sweeping tail that curls high behind her, long sweeping lashes that are actually narrow feather-plumes of silver-white, and wide eyes of deep liquid black ringed in bioluminescent teal.

A human woman with rich brick-red deep mahogany skin, heavy natural brows, eyes of vivid pale blue with chrome-bright limbal rings, and waist-length thick black hair worn in dozens of individually wrapped braids weighted with hammered metal pendants.

A Varrune woman with skin of dark teal that catches green and gold at the jaw and brow, a large arching crest of stiffened translucent membranes in place of hair that fans forward when she tilts her head, and four eyes in two horizontal pairs all of burning copper-orange.

A Solvathi woman with smooth bone-white skin dusted in a fine scatter of bioluminescent violet freckles heaviest at the cheekbones, two long graceful ivory horns that spiral gently outward from her temples, deep sea-green eyes with no visible pupil, and a fall of thick ink-black tentacle-locks trailing to her waist.
